title: Workshop for Handsome Adventurers DARK
description: Darkened GUIs of Workshop for Handsome Adventurers
body: A simple darkening of the GUIs in the Workshop for Handsome Adventures mod. I looked into most dark GUI packs and could not find one that included this so I took it upon myself to ease that eye strain.![The single bench GUI darkened](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3e573e7e29008b70b97b255b53e18f3e37376e5.png)
